       count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT c.is_out_of_scope AND json_array_length(c.expected_ids) > 0) AS scored,

panels.title: Retrieval: BM25 vs Dense vs Hybrid vs Hybrid + reranker (latest run of each system)
Retrieval systems compared
panels.description: hit@k: the right SOP is in the top k. MRR: 1 / rank of the right SOP, averaged. Lenient: a closely related SOP also counts. Latency is per query (the reranker adds an LLM call).

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (system) * FROM eval_runs WHERE kind = 'retrieval' ORDER BY system, run_at DESC)
SELECT l.system, to_char(l.run_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS run_at, m.case_count AS in_scope_cases,
       round((100 * m.hit_at_1)::numeric, 1) AS "hit@1 %", round((100 * m.hit_at_3)::numeric, 1) AS "hit@3 %",
       round((100 * m.lenient_hit_at_3)::numeric, 1) AS "lenient hit@3 %", round(m.mrr::numeric, 3) AS mrr,
       m.p50_ms, m.p95_ms, m.p99_ms, m.max_ms
FROM latest l JOIN eval_retrieval_metrics m ON m.eval_run_id = l.id AND m.scope = 'overall'
ORDER BY m.hit_at_3 DESC

panels.title: Out-of-scope detection: best score cut-off per eval set
panels.description: If the top score is below the cut-off, treat the email as 'no SOP fits'. Caught = out-of-scope emails it correctly rejects.

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (system) * FROM eval_runs WHERE kind = 'retrieval' ORDER BY system, run_at DESC)
SELECT l.system, f.key AS eval_set,
       round((f.value->>'threshold')::numeric, 2) AS cutoff,
       round((100 * (f.value->>'accuracy')::numeric), 1) AS "accuracy %",
       (f.value->>'out_of_scope_caught') || ' / ' || (f.value->>'out_of_scope_count') AS out_of_scope_caught,
       (f.value->>'in_scope_kept') || ' / ' || (f.value->>'in_scope_count') AS in_scope_kept
FROM latest l, json_each(l.summary->'score_cutoffs') AS f
ORDER BY eval_set, l.system

SELECT r.run_at AS "time", r.system AS metric, round((100 * m.hit_at_3)::numeric, 1) AS value
FROM eval_runs r JOIN eval_retrieval_metrics m ON m.eval_run_id = r.id AND m.scope = 'overall'
WHERE r.kind = 'retrieval' ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Orchestrator (gate + main agent): the whole system, for the selected gate and main agent eval runs

options.content: The **orchestrator** is what C1 calls for each thread: the **scope gate** decides, then **in_scope / mixed** go to the **main agent** and **no_issue / out_of_scope** get a template. Routing numbers are **measured** on the selected gate eval run. Cost and latency per message are **estimates**: gate cost + (share routed to the agent x main agent cost per case) from the selected main agent run. There is no joint end-to-end eval run yet.

panels.title: Routing accuracy
panels.description: Main agent or not: did each message go the right way? (selected gate run)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT routing_accuracy FROM (
WITH classes AS (SELECT unnest(ARRAY['in_scope', 'mixed', 'no_issue', 'out_of_scope']) AS cls),
per_class AS (
  SELECT c.eval_run_id, k.cls,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.expected = k.cls AND c.decision = k.cls) AS tp,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.expected <> k.cls AND c.decision = k.cls) AS fp,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.expected = k.cls AND c.decision <> k.cls) AS fn
  FROM eval_gate_cases c CROSS JOIN classes k GROUP BY 1, 2),
f1 AS (SELECT eval_run_id, avg(2.0 * tp / nullif(2 * tp + fp + fn, 0)) FILTER (WHERE tp + fn > 0) AS macro_f1
       FROM per_class GROUP BY 1),
gm AS (
  SELECT r.id, r.version, r.suite, r.run_at, count(*) AS cases,
    100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.decision = c.expected) / count(*) AS accuracy,
    100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE (c.expected IN ('in_scope', 'mixed')) = (c.decision IN ('in_scope', 'mixed'))) / count(*) AS routing_accuracy,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.wrongly_rejected) AS turned_away,
    100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.wrongly_rejected) / nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.expected IN ('in_scope', 'mixed')), 0) AS turned_away_pct,
    100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.expected NOT IN ('in_scope', 'mixed') AND c.decision IN ('in_scope', 'mixed'))
          / nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.expected NOT IN ('in_scope', 'mixed')), 0) AS extra_agent_runs_pct,
    100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.decision NOT IN ('in_scope', 'mixed')) / count(*) AS skipped_agent_pct,
    100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.expected = 'out_of_scope' AND c.decision = 'out_of_scope')
          / nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.expected = 'out_of_scope'), 0) AS oos_recall,
    100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.expected = 'out_of_scope' AND c.decision = 'out_of_scope')
          / nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.decision = 'out_of_scope'), 0) AS oos_precision,
    100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.expected = 'no_issue' AND c.decision = 'no_issue')
          / nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.expected = 'no_issue'), 0) AS no_issue_recall,
    100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.expected = 'no_issue' AND c.decision = 'no_issue')
          / nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.decision = 'no_issue'), 0) AS no_issue_precision,
    percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY c.seconds) AS p50_s,
    percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY c.seconds) AS p95_s,
    avg(c.input_tokens + c.output_tokens) AS tokens,
    avg((greatest(c.input_tokens - c.cached_tokens, 0) * coalesce(p.input_per_1m, 0) + c.cached_tokens * coalesce(p.cached_input_per_1m, 0) + c.output_tokens * coalesce(p.output_per_1m, 0)) / 1e6) AS cost_per_message
  FROM eval_runs r JOIN eval_gate_cases c ON c.eval_run_id = r.id LEFT JOIN model_prices p ON p.model = 'gpt-5.4-nano'
  WHERE r.kind = 'gate' GROUP BY r.id),
gate AS (SELECT gm.*, 100 * f1.macro_f1 AS macro_f1 FROM gm JOIN f1 ON f1.eval_run_id = gm.id) SELECT * FROM gate WHERE id::text = '${gate_run}') s

panels.title: Main agent pass rate
panels.description: Selected main agent eval run: every check and the LLM judge passed.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT pass_rate FROM (
WITH chk AS (
  SELECT eval_run_id,
    100.0 * avg(passed::int) FILTER (WHERE name = 'escalation') AS escalation,
    100.0 * avg(passed::int) FILTER (WHERE name = 'reply_decision') AS reply_decision,
    100.0 * avg(passed::int) FILTER (WHERE name = 'sop') AS sop,
    100.0 * avg(passed::int) FILTER (WHERE name IN ('tools_called', 'tools_not_called')) AS tools,
    100.0 * avg(passed::int) FILTER (WHERE name IN ('no_internal_terms', 'max_words', 'not_a_repeat', 'must_contain_any')) AS reply_rules
  FROM eval_agent_checks GROUP BY 1),
cs AS (
  SELECT a.eval_run_id, count(*) AS cases, 100.0 * avg(a.passed::int) AS pass_rate,
    percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY a.seconds) AS p50_s,
    percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY a.seconds) AS p95_s,
    avg(a.input_tokens + a.output_tokens) AS tokens, avg((greatest(a.input_tokens - a.cached_tokens, 0) * coalesce(p.input_per_1m, 0) + a.cached_tokens * coalesce(p.cached_input_per_1m, 0) + a.output_tokens * coalesce(p.output_per_1m, 0)) / 1e6) AS cost_per_case
  FROM eval_agent_cases a LEFT JOIN model_prices p ON p.model = 'gpt-5.4-mini' GROUP BY 1),
agent AS (
  SELECT r.id, r.version, r.judge_version, r.suite, r.run_at, cs.cases, cs.pass_rate, chk.escalation,
    (r.summary->>'missed_escalations')::int AS missed_escalations,
    (r.summary->>'unneeded_escalations')::int AS unneeded_escalations,
    chk.reply_decision, chk.sop, chk.tools, chk.reply_rules,
    100 * (r.summary->>'judge_rubric_item_pass_rate')::numeric AS judge_rubric,
    100 * (r.summary->>'judge_grounded_rate')::numeric AS grounded,
    cs.p50_s, cs.p95_s, cs.tokens, cs.cost_per_case
  FROM eval_runs r JOIN cs ON cs.eval_run_id = r.id LEFT JOIN chk ON chk.eval_run_id = r.id
  WHERE r.kind = 'agent') SELECT * FROM agent WHERE id::text = '${agent_run}') s

panels.title: Main agent versions compared
panels.description: Pass: every check and the judge passed. Escalation: escalated exactly when it should (missed escalations are the dangerous ones). Reply decision: replied or stayed silent correctly. SOP: followed a right SOP. Tools: called the expected tools and none of the forbidden ones. Reply rules: no internal codes, short enough, not a repeat, key facts present. Judge rubric / grounded: the LLM judge's must / must-not points, and no invented facts. $ per case: the agent's tokens only (not the judge's).

WITH chk AS (
  SELECT eval_run_id,
    100.0 * avg(passed::int) FILTER (WHERE name = 'escalation') AS escalation,
